decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already records all explicitly reassigned GPIOs. The assignment policy remains valid and no additional update or removal is required.
Selecting the WROOM-1 module does not change the auxiliary regulator, source selection, activation condition, or powered 3.3V rail.
The existing same-message MODIFY already changes 5V_EN from GPIO3 to GPIO5 and updates the dependent standby-power policy.
The module variant does not alter the DCDC1 voltage, current rating, or role as the normal 3.3V source.
The existing same-message MODIFY already updates the LED standby-power control to use 5V_EN on GPIO5. LED data GPIO13 and the remaining interface requirements are unaffected.
The WROOM-1 selection and controller GPIO reassignments do not change the sensor board's role as a connector fanout.
The selected ESP32-S3 module variant does not change the AXP2101 battery input range, power-path role, or system-load coverage.
The controller module selection and GPIO corrections do not affect the battery protection controller, cutoff thresholds, or protection components.
The WROOM-1 selection does not alter the J_BAT NTC connection or AXP2101 thermal-protection behavior.
The source decision does not change the charge-status display, GPIO13 assignment, or external charge-LED circuit.
The connector pinout carries symbolic SCL0 and 5V_EN signals, so their controller-side GPIO reassignment does not change the interboard connector definition.
Choosing the WROOM-1 module and correcting GPIO assignments does not change the number or functional partitioning of project boards.
